title: From joint probability forecasts to selective review: research code and derived evaluation data
description: Research code and author-derived evaluation data accompanying the manuscript "From Joint Probability Forecasts to Selective Review: Decision Value and Calibration Sensitivity in Electricity Monitoring" (Applied Stochastic Models in Business and Industry). The release covers synchronous high net load monitoring in Germany-Luxembourg, France and Belgium with DK1 and DK2 transfers, and adds the revision analyses: early-target against hourly-target comparison under an identical feature set, daily-cap and process-cost contract analysis, marginal-CDF perturbation of ordinary and stateful selection rules, known-mechanism simulations that separate gate crossings from capacity competition, and Danish-pivotal and price-control transfer checks. The portable reconstruction recomputes evaluation from released hourly probabilities, event indicators and forecast-only review plans, then regenerates the bootstrap contrasts and the published figures. No raw provider MW series, weather grids, price series, fitted models or credentials are included. Software is MIT licensed; author-derived data and author-written documentation are CC BY 4.0 with retained third-party terms and attribution as detailed in DATA_LICENSES.md. The evidence is a delayed historical replay, not independently validated live operational availability. Earlier deposits: version 1.0.0 at 10.5281/zenodo.23100589 and version 1.0.1 at 10.5281/zenodo.23168553.
